confidence_notes: Arica restaurant estimates from [Livingcost](https://livingcost.org/cost/chile/arica) and [HikersBay](https://hikersbay.com/prices/chile/arica?lang=en) are sparse and sometimes differ; June and later observations inform the July estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use their relationship to beer and a [local menu](https://www.aricarestobar.com/pedidos). Accommodation estimates are holistic and more uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Northern Chilean coastal cities, including Iquique, provide a qualitative lodging comparison, adjusted for Arica's smaller market and July travel demand.
